question.worked_solution:
Since $y$ varies inversely with $x,$ we use the equation

$$
y=\frac{k}{x}.
$$

Next, we use the given data $y=\frac{3}{8}$ when $x=2$ to find $k:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3}{8} & =\frac{k}{2} \\ \frac{3}{8}\cdot 2 & =k \\ \frac{6}{8} & =k \\ \frac{3}{4} & =k\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, our inverse variation equation is

$$
y=\frac{3}{4x}.
$$
